name: Itch-io
description: Browse and download GB/GBC games from Itch.io's GB Studio collection.
author: Carroarmato0

changelog.v1.0.10:
• Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts.
• Fix issue preventing to exit the app when Cloudflare blocks the connection.
• Rewrite of the build system to leverage NextUI's own toolchains, allowing the use of the native SDL library on the devices and reducing the size of the Pak.
• Some UI fixes.
• Fix launching on Miyoo Flip and TrimUI Smart Pro S.
• Support GIFs in cover art.
• New Inventory system for tracking downloaded ROMs, game updates and store removals.
• New Sorting category [DL] = Download, with Update section.
• Implement Power Control (standby and poweroff).
• Countermeasures for the "double input" hardware bug on my355.
• Log rotation.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc4:
• Implement Power Control (wakeup/poweroff).
• Fix double d-pad input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc3:
• Support GIFs in cover art.
• Enhance inventory for tracking game updates or store removal.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc2:
• Fix some UI issues.
• Prevent double input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc1:
• Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts.
• Allow exiting the Pak when Cloudflare is blocking the initial fetching of the game list.
• Rewrite build and release to use NextUI toolchains and switch to native SDL on device.
changelog.v1.0.9: Implement basic sorting in Game List.
changelog.v1.0.8: Fix the +50 owned games issue when the API returns an empty page response because there are not 51 games.

changelog.v1.0.0: Initial release — browse and download free and paid GB/GBC games from itch.io's GB Studio collection, with built-in content filters.
